name: Sheraton Kauai Resort
insider_take: This oceanfront gem sits on Poipu Beach, consistently ranked among America's best beaches, where ancient Hawaiian royalty once vacationed and monk seals still bask on the golden sand.
whats_special: The resort occupies 20 acres of prime beachfront where three distinct beaches meet - Poipu Beach, Brennecke's Beach, and Shipwreck Beach. Its location on Kauai's sunny south shore means you'll enjoy over 245 days of sunshine annually, while the rest of the island can be cloudy. The property features native Hawaiian plants and sits near the Spouting Horn blowhole, a natural lava tube that shoots water 50 feet into the air.
pro_tip: Book an ocean-view room on the Poipu Beach side for front-row seats to spectacular sunsets and potential Hawaiian monk seal sightings right from your lanai.
dont_miss: Take the short walk to Spouting Horn at sunset for dramatic photos, explore the nearby Allerton Garden (part of the National Tropical Botanical Garden), and snorkel at Poipu Beach Park where green sea turtles are frequent visitors. The resort's location also puts you minutes from Koloa town, Hawaii's first sugar plantation town with charming shops and local eateries.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Poipu Beach
Traditional Hawaiian cultural activities and programs
Easy access to Kauai's South Shore attractions
cons: Resort fee applies for amenities and services
